name: VC Trader AI Render Card
description: Read-only workspace-scoped tool: ask the platform to render an in-chat card of a given kind. The card is composed SERVER-SIDE from real platform data and reaches the user on its own frame; this tool returns only a one-line confirmation, never the card. Calls the propfirm_manager BFF as the workspace owner (PFM_AGENT_TOKEN). READ_ONLY per ADR 0078.
